scope_gaps.reason: Only the public, signed-out surface was exercised; no account was used.

scope_gaps.capability: Real consent round-trip (ask, speak, answer, act)
scope_gaps.reason: Local fixtures stub `require_approval`; the gate's class is measured, the spoken consent path is not.
No browser process was deliberately crashed.
Stability is a bounded repeated-cycle sample, not an hours-long soak.
Capture, format and bounds are measured; what a vision model makes of them is not.
This run used the current Windows machine only.
No `set_input_files`/file-chooser path exists in either tool.
The collector does not pierce shadow roots; verified rather than assumed.

scope_gaps.capability: Same- or cross-origin iframe action by semantic locator
scope_gaps.reason: Frames are resolved by the driver but not by the candidate collector.
